pt.headline: Guincho oferece ondas potentes e boas condições hoje
pt.advice: Ondas de 3.4 m com período de 12 s e vento de 7 kt são ideais para manobras. Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 1445/26 e ANAV NR 1727/26 em vigor na zona. Mar perigoso (agitação marítima) amarelo – Lisboa, surfe com cautela.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue cedo; o pico ainda não está cheio antes das 10 h.

en.headline: Guincho serves solid waves and good conditions today
en.advice: 3.4 m waves with a 12 s period and 7 kt wind are perfect for maneuvers. Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 1445/26 and ANAV NR 1727/26 in effect. Dangerous sea (yellow) – Lisbon, surf with caution.
en.crowdTip: Get there early; the spot is less crowded before 10 am.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas (3.5 m) mas nota 6/10 e avisos de interação com animais marinhos; surf moderado.
spots.enReason: Decent waves (3.5 m) but a 6/10 rating and marine‑animal interaction warnings; surf with moderation.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Melhor combinação de ondas, vento e nota 8/10; avisos de segurança apenas amarelos.
spots.enReason: Best mix of wave size, wind and an 8/10 rating; only yellow safety alerts.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Mar perigoso laranja (agitação marítima) – risco elevado; evite surfar.
spots.enReason: Orange dangerous sea alert (high agitation) – high risk; avoid surfing.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes (3.5 m) e nota 7/10; apenas avisos amarelos de animais marinhos.
spots.enReason: Consistent 3.5 m waves and a 7/10 rating; only yellow marine‑animal warnings.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de 3.5 m, vento 8 kt e nota 7/10; condições seguras com alertas amarelos.
spots.enReason: 3.5 m waves, 8 kt wind and a 7/10 rating; safe conditions with yellow alerts.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Ondas menores (2.8 m) mas nota 8/10; mar amarelo e plano de salvamento – atenção.
spots.enReason: Smaller 2.8 m waves but an 8/10 rating; yellow sea alert and rescue plan – stay alert.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de 3.1 m, vento leve (6 kt) e nota 7/10; múltiplos avisos de animais, mas sem risco crítico.
spots.enReason: 3.1 m waves, light 6 kt wind and a 7/10 rating; several marine‑animal notices but no critical risk.
